from.place: Proof paragraph 1: finite disjoint unions of qcqs pro-etale objects and their representable/evaluation comparisons.

title: Finite coproducts and evaluation on finite disjoint unions
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let X_proetale be its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let I be a finite set and, for each i in I, let V_i be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated object of X_proetale [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. The scheme disjoint union V=\coprod_{i\in I}V_i exists in the qcqs subsite and is affine when every V_i is affine. Writing h_W=Hom_X(-,W) for the representable presheaf, the canonical morphism of sheaves of sets \coprod_{i\in I}h_{V_i}\to h_V is an isomorphism, and for every sheaf of sets F on X_proetale the induced map F(V)\to\prod_{i\in I}F(V_i) is a natural bijection, including the empty family I=\varnothing, where V=\varnothing and F(∅) is a singleton.
